# Smart Pharma Consulting

> > Smart Pharma Consulting provides strategic guidance, brand planning, and operational expertise for pharmaceutical and healthcare companies in France and Europe.

Smart Pharma Consulting specializes in pharmaceutical marketing, brand strategy, medical sales optimization, and healthcare business consulting. The firm offers position papers, articles, and thought leadership on topics ranging from drug reimbursement to customer-centricity in the pharmaceutical industry.

## Key Topics

- Brand planning
- Pharmaceutical marketing
- Medical sales calls
- Customer centricity
- Drug reimbursement
- OTC business
- Self-medication
- Contract sales
- Pharmaceutical industry
- Pharma consulting
- Position papers
- Smart Pharma Care
- Healthcare strategy
- Sales force effectiveness
